title: ChatGPT Provides High-Quality Responses to Patient Questions: A Multi-Rater Evaluation by Anesthesiology Experts

live_model.evidence: "submitted to ChatGPT using the GPT-4-turbo model, OpenAI's optimized... version of GPT-4, through the official interface (chat.openai.com) on May 1, 2025".

prompt.location: Table 1 (22 questions and ChatGPT answers printed)
prompt.note: "No follow-up prompts or clarifications were provided" - single-turn queries.

claim.metric: 4-point Likert quality rating (1=excellent...4=unsatisfactory), reviewer-wise mean range 1.27-1.73
claim.location: Results ("average score per question ranged from 1.0 to 2.4"), Table 2

data.source: 22 questions printed in the paper (web-compiled FAQ list)

notes: Accessed via chat.openai.com (consumer ChatGPT UI), not the API; the served GPT-4-turbo snapshot and decoding parameters are not controllable or reproducible via script.
